proposed_comments.title: (1/3) Scope generated WXS files to file-list templates
proposed_comments.body:
### (1/3) Scope generated WXS files to file-list templates

**Severity:** `low`

The generator copies the file-list templates into `obj\<platform>\Generated`; it does not make every WXS source a generated template. Monaco remains a separate source. Please describe the file-list templates specifically.

```suggestion
- File-list .wxs templates for installer components are copied into `installer\PowerToysSetupVNext\obj\<platform>\Generated` during the build
```

confidence.rationale: The pinned generator defaults to obj\<platform>\Generated for file-list templates, while Monaco is produced by a separate script.

proposed_comments.title: (2/3) Scope the deterministic GUID claim
proposed_comments.body:
### (2/3) Scope the deterministic GUID claim

**Severity:** `low`

The UUIDv5 derivation applies to file-list components emitted by `generateAllFileComponents.ps1`, not every generated component. Monaco is harvested separately with Heat's `-gg` option and its cleanup component receives a fresh GUID. Please limit the reproducibility claim to the file-list components.

```suggestion
- File-list components emitted by `generateAllFileComponents.ps1` use UUIDv5 GUIDs derived from component ID, install scope, platform and file set; other generated WiX sources, including Monaco, are not deterministic
```

confidence.rationale: The pinned file-list generator uses UUIDv5, but the separate Monaco generator invokes Heat with -gg and assigns a fresh New-Guid value to its cleanup component.

proposed_comments.title: (3/3) Document the separate Monaco generation step
proposed_comments.body:
### (3/3) Document the separate Monaco generation step

**Severity:** `low`

This wording says all WXS files are regenerated into `obj\`, but `generateMonacoWxs.ps1` writes `MonacoSRC.wxs` separately. Please distinguish the file-list templates from that separate Monaco output.

```suggestion
- File-list WXS templates are generated under `obj\`; Monaco WXS is separately generated into `MonacoSRC.wxs`
```

confidence.rationale: The pinned Monaco generator explicitly sets its output to MonacoSRC.wxs beside the script, independently of the obj template output.

proposed_comments.title: Suppress the pre-build command for MSI-only passes
proposed_comments.body:
### Suppress the pre-build command for MSI-only passes

**Severity:** `medium`

`PowerToysInstallerVNext.wixproj` defines a nonempty `PreBuildEvent`, but the `RunBuildEvents=false` condition only sets `PreBuildEventUseInBuild=false`. The imported MSBuild pre-build target checks the command text for emptiness, so the machine/user MSI passes still execute the `publish.cmd` and Monaco generation command instead of relying only on the shared-support pass. Clear `PreBuildEvent` for the MSI-only passes.

```suggestion
    <PreBuildEvent></PreBuildEvent>
```

confidence.rationale: On the pinned source, the MSI-only configuration left the pre-build command nonempty and it executed; clearing that command removed the event, and the literal candidate MSI targets passed.
